sentences.text: ..... Respondents Counsel for the petitioner : Mr.Dasari SVVSV Prasad Counsel for the respondents :

The writ petition is filed to declare the action of the respondents without paying compensation for the land in Survey No.165-2A to an extent of Ac.0.25 cents, Survey No.165-3A1 to an extent of Ac.0.40 cents and Survey No.165-3A2A to an extent of Ac.0.40 cents, totalling to an extent of Ac.1.05 cents situated at Kappalabanda Revenue Village, Puttaparthi Mandal, Sri Satya Sai District acquired by the respondents for formation of National Highway No.342, widening of existing road to Two lane with paved shoulder from Km.32/0 to 79/650 (Design Ch.32+000 to 78+650)
Puttaparthi-Kodur Section of NH-342 in Sri Satyasai District of Andhra Pradesh under the National Highways Act, 1956(48/1956) read with National Highways Laws(Amendment) Act, 1997 is illegal,
arbitrary, improper, unjust and violation of Articles 14, 19, 21 and 300-A of Constitution of India and violation of the Right to Fair Compensation Land in Transparency Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and for a consequential direction to the respondents to pay the compensation to the petitioner.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition representing the 4th respondent placed a copy of the written instructions dated 11.01.2024 received from the 6th respondent, from a reading of which, it would appear that the petitioner had not submitted the relevant documents during the Award Enquiry.
In the said instructions, it is also mentioned that the petitioner is at liberty to file documents in support of her claim.

sentences.text: 3. In view of the same, the petitioner may approach the respondent No.4 and produce the documents of title in respect of the petitioner's right over the subject matter property.
If the petitioner approaches the 4th respondent with relevant documents, the claim of the petitioner shall be examined, in accordance with the Law.
4. With the above observations, the writ petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
